description: Delicata is an oblong, cylindrical, cream-colored squash with green and sometimes orange stripes. Like all squash, it grows on vines. It has deep orange flesh that tastes like a sweet potato, but sweeter. Delicata is consumed as a winter squash, but is actually in the same species as summer squash: Cucurbita pepo. Delicata is delicious roasted, baked, sauteed, or steamed. When roasted or baked, the rind can be eaten as well.
sowing_method: Direct seed in groups of 2, thin to 1 plant when seedling have 2 sets of adult leaves

companions.notes: openfarm-crops-rescue lists this as a companion without indicating polarity; assumed 'good' per common convention
